heading.title: Rules in cases of Intestates other than Parsis

article.title: Rules of distribution where intestate has left no lineal descendants.
article.content: Where an intestate has left no lineal descendants, the rules for the distribution of his property (after deducting the widow’s share, if he has left a widow) shall be those contained in sections 42 to 48.
article.html:
41Rules of distribution where intestate has left no lineal descendants.

Section 41 · Part V · Chapter II · page 24 of the Act

Where an intestate has left no lineal descendants, the rules for the distribution of his property (after deducting the widow’s share, if he has left a widow) shall be those contained in sections 42 to 48.
